Fiscal Years
item.description:
Fiscal Years need to be created and managed using the frontend interface.

To select the Fiscal Year used on API requests, is provided a way to list company Fiscal Years and select the one that will be used on API requests.
After selecting a Fiscal Year a new token is provided on the response, which must be used on following requests.

item.name: Reports
item.description:
Reports are supported by API with the same options as the frontend reports.

Each report is a single request, and not a collection, this implies the need to send a resource identifier in the request, which may have any value.
Being a single request, pagination is not supported.
